title: Measure dense extraction ownership memory before redesign
description: MarchingCubesExtractor now uses direct dense integer ownership tables instead of a Dictionary<long,int>. The lookup cost is improved, but the dense corner/edge arrays can become a meaningful native/managed memory consumer at high voxel resolutions. Measure peak memory for representative preview qualities and grid dimensions, separately account for corner and X/Y/Z edge ownership, and compare it with the removed dictionary overhead before considering a sparse/chunked ownership representation. Do not redesign based on estimates alone.
